name: byjg
description: Agent Skills for the ByJG open source components, published from their repositories.

plugins.name: feature-workflow
plugins.description: Guided workflow for adding new features or fixing bugs in DockNimbus. Use this skill whenever the user asks to add a feature, fix a bug, implement a new API endpoint, add a CLI command, modify the UI, change agent behavior, or any task that involves changing functionality across the codebase layers (types, SDK, API handlers, repository, CLI, UI, agent). Trigger on phrases like 'add feature', 'fix bug', 'implement X', 'new command', 'new endpoint', 'agent not working', 'UI missing X', or any request that touches application logic. Even if the user mentions only one layer (e.g. 'fix the agent'), use this skill because the root cause often spans multiple layers.

plugins.name: gluo-developer
plugins.description: Create, develop and maintain PHP REST APIs with byjg/gluo: new projects, endpoints, models, persistence, DI configuration, migrations, authentication, OpenAPI, and tests. Use whenever creating or working on a Gluo PHP application, even for generic requests such as "start a new PHP API", "add a new endpoint" or "fix this bug" that do not name Gluo explicitly. Follow the project's installed dependency versions and existing conventions. Frontend-only work needs this skill only when it changes the API integration.

plugins.name: shellscript-add
plugins.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to add a new installer script to the shellscript.download project. Trigger when the user says things like "add a script for X", "create a new script to install Y", "write a .sh for Z", "add <tool> to the catalog", or any request to create or write a new public/scripts/*.sh file. Also trigger when the user asks how to contribute a new script or what the pattern for a new script looks like.
